aboutIntro: Software engineer with a strong foundation in data structures, object-oriented design, and database systems, and particular depth in full-stack MERN development (React, Node.js, Express, MongoDB). Has designed multi-service systems, including a deterministic recommendation engine and a role-based access-control platform, with production experience across Java and C/C++ as well.
